changeSet.author: GA-Lotse
changeSet.sql: UPDATE abstract_aggregation_result SET data_sensitivity = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation e JOIN table_column tc ON e.id = tc.aggregation_result_id WHERE abstract_aggregation_result.id = e.id AND e.anonymized = FALSE AND tc.business_module_name = 'INSPECTION' ) THEN 'INTERNAL_USAGE'::statisticsdatasensitivity WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation e JOIN table_column tc ON e.id = tc.aggregation_result_id WHERE abstract_aggregation_result.id = e.id AND e.anonymized = FALSE AND tc.business_module_name = 'SCHOOL_ENTRY' ) THEN 'SENSITIVE'::statisticsdatasensitivity WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM report r WHERE abstract_aggregation_result.id = r.id ) THEN 'ANONYMOUS'::statisticsdatasensitivity ELSE 'ANONYMOUS'::statisticsdatasensitivity END;
